units.text: INT. GHOSTS - CONTINUOUS
We must stand by Engstrand and his Sailors' Home. Regina must go to him and help him--
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: No thank you, sir.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Noticing her for the first time.
What--? You here? And with a glass in your hand!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Hastily putting the glass down.
Pardon!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Regina is going with me, Mr. Manders.
units.name: OSWALD

units.text: Going! With you!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Yes; as my wife--if she wishes it.
units.name: OSWALD

units.text: But, merciful God--!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: I can't help it, sir.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Or she'll stay here, if I stay.
units.name: OSWALD

units.text: Involuntarily.
Here!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: I am thunderstruck at your conduct, Mrs. Alving.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: They will do neither one thing nor the other; for now I can speak out plainly.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: You surely will not do that! No, no, no!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Yes, I can speak and I will. And no ideals shall suffer after all.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Mother--what is it you are hiding from me?
units.name: OSWALD

units.text: Listening.
Oh, ma'am, listen! Don't you hear shouts outside.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: She goes into the conservatory and looks out.
At the window on the left.
What's going on? Where does that light come from?
units.name: OSWALD

units.text: Cries out.
The Orphanage is on fire!
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Rushing to the window.
On fire!
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: On fire! Impossible! I've just come from there.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Where's my hat? Oh, never mind it--Father's Orphanage--!
units.name: OSWALD

units.text: He rushes out through the garden door.
My shawl, Regina! The whole place is in a blaze!
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Terrible! Mrs. Alving, it is a judgment upon this abode of lawlessness.
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: Yes, of course. Come, Regina.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: She and REGINA hasten out through the hall.
Clasps his hands together.
And we left it uninsured!
units.name: MANDERS

units.text: He goes out the same way.
The room as before.
All the doors stand open.
The lamp is still burning on the table.
It is dark out of doors; there is only a faint glow from the conflagration in the background to the left.
MRS. ALVING, with a shawl over her head, stands in the conservatory, looking out.
REGINA, also with a shawl on, stands a little behind her.
The whole thing burnt!--burnt to the ground!
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: The basement is still burning.
units.name: REGINA

units.text: How is it Oswald doesn't come home? There's nothing to be saved.
units.name: MRS. ALVING

units.text: Should you like me to take down his hat to him?
units.name: REGINA

units.text: Has he not even got his hat on?
units.name: MRS. ALVING
